args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted. In every run, each final check that was run passed.
Flagged (2): r05 and r06, reason summary_outlier. Their largest flank difference is at 295 µm from the tip, against 42–84 µm in the other runs. Their width-free ratio is negative (-0.035) while the others range from 0.064 to 0.093. Together these show a curvature-rate profile of a different shape. Their REGR peak z of 8.09 is only 0.12 %/h because the batch MAD is very small, so I did not count it as evidence.
Cleared (6): r01, r02, r03, r04, r07, r08. The checks that were run pass. All six have the REGR peak at 421 µm and a growth zone of 674–684 µm. The flank difference in r04 and r08 has the opposite sign, which means the root bends the other way. It is not a fault.
What r05 and r06 share: both use the width-free ratio and register frames from 400 px. r04 used the same remedies and settings and looks normal, so the settings alone do not explain the problem. It is in the flank-difference and width-free-ratio profiles, while their centre strain rate matches the batch.
